1531153/ CUrmT - na You BL- h9 w汀-啦b+30 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT (this“Agreement"),made as of August 2, 2004, by and among AUSTIN INTERNATIONAL REALTY, LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an office at 95 Forest Avenue, Locust Valley, New York (hereinafter referred to as the “Austin"), and 47 EAST 34th STREET HOLDING, LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an office at c/o Michael Silberberg, 600 Third Avenue, 25"h floor, New York, New York 10016 (hereinafter referred to as “Builders"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Austin is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the City and State of New York, County of New York, known as and by the street address 51 East 34" Street, New York, New York, and designated as Tax Lot 30 in Block 864, and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and provisions of this agreement, being herein called the “Austin Building", and the Austin Land and the Austin Building being herein collectively referred to as the “Austin Premises"); WHEREAS,Builders is the owner in fee title of certain parcels of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the City and State of New York, County of New York, known as and by the street addresses 49 East 34"h Street, New York, New York and 47 East 34th Street, New York, New York, and designated as Tax Lots 29 and 28, respectively, in Block 864, and more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part of hereof (said land being hereinafter referred to as the “Builders Land,” said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this agreement, being herein called the “Builders Building", and the Builders Land, and either the Builders Building or once the Builders Building has been demolished and the New Building (hereinafter defined) has been constructed, the New Building being herein collectively referred to as the“Builders Premises"); WHEREAS, Builders intends to construct one or more new buildings upon all or a portion of the Builders Land (said new building or buildings, with any further additions, alterations and replacements thereof, being herein called the “New Building"; the Austin Land and the Builders Land are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the “Parcels" and each individually as a "Parcel"); WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the New Building will contain more floor area (herein referred to as “Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15,1961 (the “Zoning Resolution") than is now available for use under the “floor area ratio" limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution related to the Builders Land if treated as an independent “zoning lot;” RE\0777510003/260530v6 1

WHEREAS, there exist Floor Area Development Rights (hereinafter defined)which are appurtenant to the Austin Land which are not currently utilized and the same are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, the parties hereto desire to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution to combine the Austin Land and the Builders Land into a combined zoning lot for the purpose of determining compliance by the New Building with the “floor area ratio" limitation contained in the ZoningResolution; NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of Ten Dollars ($10.00) and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows: ARTICLEI DECLARATIONOFRESTRICTIONS Section 1.1.  The parties hereto are, simultaneously herewith, executing and delivering a Declaration of Restrictions, as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (herein called the “Declaration"), a copy of which Declaration is annexed hereto as Exhibit B and made a part hereof, which seeks to effectuate the intentions of the parties set forth in the preamble to this Agreement by creating a single zoning lot (hereinafter referred to as the “Combined Zoning Lot") comprising of the Austin Land and theBuilders Land. ARTICLE II DEVELOPMENTRIGHTS Section 2.1.The term “Retained Development Rights" shall refer to a total of 7,968.75 square feet of Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the Austin Land, which will be Development Rights,” which amounts to a total of 66,093.75 square feet of Floor Area Development Rights, shall mean (i) the Floor Area Development Rights for any permitted use appurtenant to the Combined Zoning Lot as of the date hereof, less (i) the Retained Development Rights. As used in this Agreement, the terms “floor area,”“community facility,”" "use" and “zoning lot”" shall have the meanings as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. Section 2.2.Austin hereby transfers to Builders the Available Development Rights, incorporation of the Available Development Rights into the New Building and the utilization of the Available Development Rights to develop the Builders Land. Builders hereby acknowledges itself and all other rights (exclusive of the Available Development Rights) unto itself pertaining to the Austin Land as the same exists on the date hereof, and reserves the right to use such Retained Development Rights for any and all lawful purposes which may include, without limitation, the development, redevelopment, construction in addition to reconstruction, and RE\07775\0003\260530v6 2
